issue: NavigationService.observe_dynamic_obstacles renewed per-cell expiry each scan, then compared old cell keys with expiry timestamps. The sets always differed, so dynamic_obstacle_revision advanced on every scan and MissionController repeatedly stopped/cancelled a valid route.
fix: Compare the inflated blocked-cell set before and after the observation update. A stable hit renews TTL without reporting a route-affecting revision; expiry or geometry changes still increment it.
